Job Summary

Job Title- Group Data Privacy (GDP) - Data Privacy Analyst, AS

Location- Bangalore, India

Role Description

  • CAFC is responsible for managing the compliance and anti-financial crime risk of Deutsche Bank Group. Our mission is to ensure that CAFC services are provided to the bank with the goals of protecting its integrity and reputation and managing legal risk to make transactions viable and safe. We partner with Risk, Regulation, Legal, Group Audit and others to provide a proactive integrated risk management approach.
  • We work closely with managers to coordinate activities across business lines so we avoid violations of laws. We make sure the Bank has up-to-date information on regulatory and legal changes and continues to be seen as a trusted, respected market participant.

Group Data Privacy (GDP)

  • Group Data Privacy (GDP) is an independent 2nd Line of Defense risk type control function within Legal which defines the risk management framework for data protection and privacy risks. GDP is located in Frankfurt, New York, London, and Berlin and Bangalore organized in a matrix structure with regional Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and Business Partners providing guidance to Business Divisions and Infrastructure Functions.
  • Moreover, GDP manages a global network of local, internal data protection officers and rolled-out a controls framework in order to safeguard Deutsche Bank s integrity and reputation and to ensure the correct processing of personal data entrusted to us. As part of the TPRM process, as a 2LoD control function, GDP is mandated to review third party outsourcing activities adherence with data privacy requirements.

Your key responsibilities

  • Advise and perform on the Data Protection Impact Assessment, in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line and the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the DPIA relevant facts, the (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures.
  • Adivse and support in the banks global AI related governance process (AI Oversight Forum), in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line, the other Risk Function in the AIOF as well the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the AI use case, support the identification of (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures in a timely manner .
  • Advise and perform the initial review of Data Breach notifications ensuring that the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO are timely involved and support them with their Data Breach assessment and documentation in order to avoid and mitigate potential data privacy risks
  • Advise and support the Service Officers of divisions and infrastructure functions on Data Protection related controls, attestations and evidences and GDP Assessment in order to meet the data protection requirements including Schrems II requirements.
  • Remain informed of regulatory developments in the data protection related outsourcing requirements including relevant GDP Policies and procedures as well as (assist if required in) maintenance of GDP Key Operating Documents

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of the data privacy regulatory requirements applicable to DB incl. the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and remain up-to-date with relevant regulatory requirements and industry trends.
  • Maintain close collaboration with other functions within GDP such as Law Monitoring and Training Awareness.
  • Provide ad hoc support for Controls Assurance activities when required.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

What You Do at AMD Changes Everything

MTS Power and Performance Engineer

The Role

AMD s Computing and Graphics business unit is seeking a technical leader to drive next generation power architecture, firmware, algorithms, and software interfaces across AMD client and handheld SoCs. In this highly influential role, you will help define the power management architecture for future AMD platforms driving innovation from early concept and definition, through design execution, and into post silicon validation.
You will collaborate closely with SoC and platform architects, IP and physical design teams, software and firmware engineering, silicon validation, and packaging teams to deliver breakthrough improvements in power efficiency, performance per watt, and battery life. This is an opportunity to have a direct and visible impact on AMD s most advanced products. This senior role will stretch you as you lead architecture teams in new directions, network with our world-class, patent-holding think-tank, and negotiate amongst design teams, marketing, and business unit executives.

The Person

You are a deep technical thinker with strong problem solving and communication skills. You excel at explaining complex concepts through publications, presentations, or executive briefings.
You thrive in highly collaborative environments, mentor others naturally, and raise the collective expertise of the teams around you. You combine practical hands on skills with system level vision, and you are energized by building algorithms and firmware that shape silicon behavior.

Key Responsibilities

Algorithm, Firmware Software Interface Architecture

  • Develop and architect new power algorithms and software features using state of the art techniques, including classfiers, regression models, machine learning approches for CPU/GPU power and performance optimization.
  • Define and implement software interfaces that influence and optimize hardware behavior across the SoC.
  • Prototype and develop new firmware for complex power control algorithms throughout the SoC roadmap.

Performance Workload Optimization

  • Profile emerging NN and LLM (Agentic) workloads on client platforms; tune algorithms to optimize power during active, high load, and interactive usage scenarios.
  • Analyze power and performance benchmarks to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.

System Level Power Architecture

  • Architect, implement, and optimize control software and firmware features to achieve product level power targets.
  • Drive cross organization alignment for innovative power reduction methodologies and ensure convergence across design teams.
  • Collaborate with global architecture and design teams to implement and validate SoC power management solutions.
  • Optimize real PC use cases for both absolute power and performance per watt.

Hands On Engineering

  • Work directly with development boards to prototype new features and evaluate new power features.
  • Conduct software tracing, firmware debugging, and activity profiling to diagnose issues and drive improvements.

Preferred Experience

  • Prefer 8+ years of industry experience
  • Experience profiling software workloads on CPUs and GPUs.
  • Knowledge of defining low level software interfaces to influence hardware performance and power behavior.
  • Background in SOC hardware design, clock distribution, power delivery and performance
  • Experience profiling and tuning hardware/software stacks to achieve power and performance efficiency on benchmark workloads.
  • Prior algorithm development in C or Python; MATLAB experience preferred.

  • Experience with system and SoC control firmware, including RTOS and bare metal development.
  • Familiarity with ACPI, UEFI, and platform level power management frameworks.
  • Demonstrated expertise in system and SoC power optimization techniques.
  • Experience with software tracing, firmware debugging, and activity profiling tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to lead and influence teams across geographies.

PhD or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
It's not just about your career or job title. It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. The Wabtec Data Analytics (DA) team is driving the company's next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise and experience across data engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Science to enable scalable, governed, and intelligent self-service solutions.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in SharePoint to promote adoption and consistent usage.

  • Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns.
  • Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance.
  • Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data.
  • Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs.
Qualifications/Requirements
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in self-service and analytics platforms including Denodo, Dataiku and Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms (Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock) for designing and developing intelligent agents and workflow automation.
  • Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Hands-on experience or internships in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms.

title: AI Prompt Engineer
jobDescription:
About the role

Prompting is engineering here, not trial and error. You will own the prompt and evaluation layer of real AI products: agents, retrieval pipelines and in-product copilots that run against live traffic. The job is to make model behaviour measurable and repeatable, so the team can change a model or a prompt and know, with numbers, whether the system got better or worse.

What you will do
  • Design, version and test prompts for production agents, RAG systems and copilots, and document why each change moved the metric.
  • Build evaluation suites that catch regressions before users do, with graded test sets and clear pass and fail thresholds.
  • Tune retrieval and context assembly so the model gets the right information, not just more of it.
  • Write guardrails and fallbacks for the cases that break a demo: refusals, hallucinations, jailbreaks and long-tail inputs.
  • Work with the engineers serving the model on latency, cost-per-call and token budgets, the numbers Production-First AI locks first.
  • Turn what you learn into reusable prompt patterns and eval templates the wider AI practice can pick up.
What we are looking for
  • 2 to 5 years working with LLMs in a hands-on role, with shipped or near-shipped features you can talk through.
  • Strong Python, and comfort reading and writing code around an API rather than only using a playground.
  • A real understanding of evaluation: you can explain how you would prove a prompt change is an improvement, not a vibe.
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings and vector search, and the failure modes each one brings.
  • Precise written reasoning, since most of this job is making model behaviour legible to other engineers.
Nice to have
  • Experience with eval tooling such as Ragas or Braintrust, and tracing tools for agent runs.
  • Hands-on time with LangGraph or a similar orchestration framework.
  • A background in linguistics, applied ML or data science.
What we offer
  • Real production problems against live traffic, not prompt demos that never deploy.
  • A method built around evaluation, so your work is measured by numbers rather than opinion.
  • Senior AI engineers to build with and a bench that has carried AI to production since the shift in 2026.

Overview

Design and deliver end-to-end AI infrastructure architecture for enterprise clients - setting the architecture vision for compute, networking, retrieval, agent orchestration, and the tooling layers that underpin every AI and agentic workload.

Serve as the trusted technical advisor to client architects and technology leads on AI infrastructure decisions, translating architectural choices into clear trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, and security.

This is a design and architecture role, not a hands-on build role. The mandate is to define standards, reference architectures, and governance frameworks that engineering teams implement.

It does not focus on model development, prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, or AI application development. Applications from AI Engineers, Prompt Engineers, or ML practitioners without infrastructure architecture experience are unlikely to be a strong fit.


Key Responsibilities


1. AI Compute Infrastructure Architecture

  • Design cloud AI infrastructure for enterprise workloads - GPU/CPU compute, Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE), managed ML compute, networking, identity, and security across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Define reference architecture for AI Center of Excellence infrastructure - model hosting, agent environments, and the compute and networking beneath them.
  • Architect compute strategy - GPU SKU selection, GPU economics and capacity planning, provisioned vs pay-as-you-go inference, and shared vs dedicated capacity models.

title: Presentation & AI Content Designer
tagsAndSkills: Figma,Content Writing,PowerPoint,Chatgpt,adobe photoshop,Ai Solutions,Corporate Communication,Adobe Suite
jobDescription:
INNOVERV | CAREERS

Presentation & AI Content Designer

India-based | Remote | UK business hours

Create consulting-quality presentations, digital content and visual storytelling for a fast-growing UK-headquartered technology consultancy.

Location: India, remote
Working hours: UK business hours
Employment type: Full-time, permanent
Experience: 3-7 years preferred
Reports to: Leadership / Marketing
Compensation: INR 10-15 lakhs per annum, depending on experience, portfolio quality and assessment performance

About the Role

This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We are looking for someone who combines expert PowerPoint skills, strong visual judgement, professional business writing and practical use of AI tools.

The successful candidate will transform rough ideas, notes and source materials into polished executive presentations, persuasive visual narratives and professional digital content.

About Innoverv

Innoverv is a fast-growing UK-headquartered consulting firm specialising in SAP, enterprise transformation, data, AI and digital change.

We work with senior executives and large organisations across sectors including retail, manufacturing, life sciences and engineering.

Our presentations and content support board-level discussions, major client proposals, transformation programmes, thought-leadership campaigns and executive communications. We are building an in-house creative capability in India to improve the quality, pace and consistency of this work.

The Opportunity

You will work closely with Innovervs leadership and consulting teams to convert rough notes, sketches, voice notes, source materials and emerging ideas into clear, persuasive and visually distinctive content.

You must be comfortable improving both the design and the underlying message, rather than simply formatting slides.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-quality PowerPoint presentations for CIOs, CFOs, board members and programme leadership teams.
  • Convert rough or unstructured content into coherent storylines, executive summaries and well-structured presentations.
  • Create consulting-style diagrams, including operating models, roadmaps, process maps, architectures, organisation structures, timelines and transformation journeys.
  • Develop visual concepts and reusable slide templates aligned with the Innoverv brand.
  • Create graphics, illustrations, icons and other visual assets using appropriate design and AI tools.
  • Write and edit professional English content for LinkedIn posts, website pages, case studies, proposals, brochures and thought-leadership materials.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, drafting and design while maintaining quality, accuracy, originality and the appropriate tone.
  • Deliver time-sensitive client and leadership requests quickly and reliably, often with limited supervision.
  • Maintain organised file structures, version control and confidentiality across client materials.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Expert-level PowerPoint skills and a strong portfolio of original work.
  • Excellent written and spoken professional English.
  • Strong visual judgement and a disciplined approach to layout, typography and information design.
  • Ability to understand complex business concepts and simplify them visually.
  • High levels of reliability, responsiveness and attention to detail.
  • Comfort working UK business hours and collaborating directly with senior colleagues.

Desirable Skills and Experience

  • Experience supporting consulting, technology, professional-services or executive audiences.
  • Exposure to SAP, enterprise technology, business transformation or B2B services.
  • Experience producing proposals, pitch decks, board papers or thought-leadership content.
  • Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Canva or similar tools.
  • Basic video, animation or motion-graphics capability.
  • Experience working in a digital agency, presentation studio, research unit or strategy-firm support centre.

Academic Qualifications

Candidates should normally hold a recognised bachelor’s degree or an equivalent professional qualification.

Relevant disciplines may include:

  • Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design or Applied Arts
  • Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Marketing or Digital Media
  • Business, Economics, Engineering or Technology, supported by an outstanding presentation and content portfolio

A degree alone will not be sufficient. Portfolio quality, English fluency, business understanding, reliability and performance in the practical assessment will carry greater weight.

Preferred Candidate Backgrounds

Strong candidates may come from:

  • Digital, branding, web-design or B2B content agencies serving corporate clients
  • Presentation-design studios or pitch-deck specialist firms
  • Knowledge, research, proposal, graphics or communications teams supporting strategy and management-consulting firms
  • Offshore or captive support centres producing executive presentations and reports
  • Corporate marketing or communications teams within technology and professional-services organisations
  • Independent presentation designers with a strong record of supporting senior executives

Tools and Technology

Candidates must be highly capable in Microsoft PowerPoint and comfortable using a practical selection of the following tools:

Core Tools

  • Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Microsoft Word
  • Microsoft 365

Design Tools

  • Figma
  • Canva
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • Adobe Photoshop

AI and Productivity Tools

  • ChatGPT
  • Microsoft Copilot
  • Gamma
  • Beautiful.ai
  • Adobe Firefly and other image-generation tools
  • Miro
  • Whimsical
  • Napkin AI

Personal Qualities

  • Creative, curious and commercially aware
  • Dependable and disciplined about deadlines
  • Able to challenge weak structure or unclear messaging constructively
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly
  • Self-motivated, organised and calm under pressure
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential client information

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Producing board-ready and client-ready presentations with limited supervision
  • Converting unstructured input into clear and persuasive visual narratives
  • Creating content that is distinctive, modern and consistent with Innoverv’s positioning
  • Using AI to improve speed and creativity without compromising judgement or quality
  • Becoming a trusted and responsive partner to Innoverv’s leadership and consulting teams

Working Pattern

This is a full-time, permanent and remote role based in India.

Working hours will be aligned with UK business hours. In India, this will typically involve an afternoon and evening schedule, which may vary depending on UK daylight-saving time.

Occasional travel or in-person meetings may be required.

Innoverv expects to appoint two or three people to build a dependable internal presentation and content capability.

Application Requirements

Applicants should provide:

  • An up-to-date CV and current compensation details
  • A portfolio of personally created PowerPoint work, which is mandatory
  • Two or three original PowerPoint files, rather than only PDFs or screenshots
  • Examples of written content, such as LinkedIn posts, website copy, proposals or articles
  • Examples of work created or accelerated using AI tools, with a brief explanation of the candidate’s contribution
  • A two- to three-minute video introduction in English

Selection Process

1. Initial Screening

Review of the candidate’s CV, portfolio and English-language video introduction.

2. Practical Assessment

A timed exercise covering slide redesign, diagram creation and LinkedIn content development.

3. Interview

Discussion of design choices, working style, business understanding and use of AI tools.

4. Reference Checks

Reference checks focused on reliability, ownership and delivery discipline.

Practical Assessment

Shortlisted candidates will complete a controlled, time-boxed assessment that may include:

  • Redesigning five to eight pages from a deliberately rough business presentation
  • Turning a one-page brief into a clear transformation roadmap or operating-model diagram
  • Converting a 250–350-word leadership note into a concise LinkedIn post and accompanying visual concept
  • Explaining which AI tools were used, what was generated, what was edited and how quality was checked

Candidates will be assessed on their thinking, visual judgement, English, originality, speed and reliability—not simply on how polished their existing portfolio appears.

Equal Opportunity

Innoverv is an equal-opportunity employer. We value originality, integrity, reliability and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly.

About NxtWave

NxtWave is one of India's fastest-growing ed-tech startups, reshaping the tech education landscape by bridging the gap between industry needs and student readiness. With prestigious recognitions such as Technology Pioneer 2024 by the World Economic Forum and Forbes India 30 Under 30, NxtWave's impact continues to grow rapidly across India.

About the Role

Every year, NxtWave prepares thousands of students to become software engineers — but preparation only counts if it converts into an actual offer. Somewhere between "assessment-qualified" and "hired" is a gap that no curriculum update alone can close: the right student needs to be matched to the right opportunity, coached through a hiring process that shifts every quarter, and given a real shot when it's on the line. That gap is yours to close.

You'll own placement outcomes for one product/program end-to-end — not as a support function to the Placement Partnership team (CRMs), but as the person deciding who gets shortlisted, how they're prepped, why they got rejected, and what needs to change next. The hiring opportunities you work with, and the curriculum your students come from, are Software Engineering roles — SDE, full stack, backend, and beyond. You'll need to actually understand the code your students are being tested on, not just the process around it.

Hiring itself is changing fast in the AI era — interview formats, assignments, and skill bars are all shifting under AI's influence. You'll need to notice that shift before it shows up in your placement numbers, and use AI yourself to keep your team ahead of it rather than reacting to it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Candidate Shortlisting: Own the shortlisting process for your program/product — matching students to software engineering hiring opportunities based on resume quality, technical skills, assessment performance, mock interview performance, and company-specific eligibility criteria.
  • Candidate Preparation & Mentorship: Drive assessment prep, assignment guidance, interview prep, company-specific mentoring, and last-minute doubt resolution for shortlisted students across every stage of the hiring process.
  • Rejection Selection Analysis (RSA): Own the post-process analysis loop for your program/product — capture reasons for selection/rejection, stage-wise elimination, and skill gaps, and turn findings into curriculum, assessment, and process changes, not just a report.
  • Hiring Intelligence: Continuously gather intelligence on interview questions, assessment patterns, coding problems, assignment trends, and company/industry expectations; convert this into better prep resources and mentoring strategies before your students walk in, not after they walk out.
  • AI-Driven Process Improvement: Use AI tools to improve how the team works — automating parts of shortlisting and reporting, generating and personalizing prep content, running AI-based mock interviews, and speeding up RSA analysis — rather than only running these processes manually.
  • Team Leadership: Build, manage, and coach a team (Technical Mentors) of 8–10 members with clear weekly KPIs tied to placement outcomes, not just activity volume.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Partnership Partnership, Placement Operations, Assessment, and Curriculum teams to close the loop between hiring intelligence/RSA insights and actual improvements in student outcomes.

Key Outcomes

  • Hiring Positions Filled: Maximize the number of open hiring positions filled by students in your program/product.
  • Placement Rate of Assessment-Qualified Students: Improve the placement rate of students who have qualified the internal assessment criteria for your program/product.
  • RSA-Driven Improvements: Convert rejection analysis into a defined number of actionable improvements each week across curriculum, assessments, or prep processes.
  • Hiring Intelligence Repository: Maintain a live, actionable repository of hiring intelligence for your program/product that feeds curriculum, assessment, and mentoring updates.
  • Team Performance: Run a high-performing team of 8–10 with clear weekly KPIs on shortlisting throughput, mentoring coverage, and prep-to-placement conversion.

Non-Negotiables

  • 5+ years of overall experience with programming and software development background — comfortable evaluating code, DSA, and technical assessments, since every opportunity and curriculum is Software Engineering-focused.
  • Experience managing or closely leading a team of 3–5 members on similar operating systems.

You Might Be a Good Fit If

  • You can look at a rejected candidate's interview feedback and immediately see three things that should change — not just for that student, but for the whole cohort.
  • You've run structured, data-led shortlisting before, and you get uncomfortable when a placement process runs on gut feel instead of signal.
  • You've turned hiring intelligence — interview patterns, coding trends, company expectations — into real changes in how students get prepared, not a slide that gets forgotten after the debrief.
  • You notice hiring bars shifting before anyone else does, and you're already rebuilding your playbook around it rather than waiting for someone to tell you AI changed the rules.
  • You use AI as part of how you work, not just how you talk about work — you'd rather rebuild your team's shortlisting or prep process around it than bolt it on as an extra step.
  • You can influence other related teams without direct authority, because you make people want to act on what you found rather than just agree with it in the room.
  • You're comfortable being judged on outcomes — positions filled, placement rate — not on how many activities you have done.

Strong Candidates May Also Have

  • Prior experience in ed-tech, campus placements, or talent acquisition.
  • Familiarity with technical hiring processes (coding assessments, technical interviews) relevant to software/tech roles.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • You get to own outcomes for real people's careers, not a project or a dashboard — every "positions filled" number is someone's first job, some family uplifted.
  • You're building the placement playbook as hiring itself is being rewritten by AI — get it right here and it becomes how every other program runs placements.

Define the AI Testing Practice

Roll out testing practices directly with engineering teams and, where required, at client locations 
Drive AI Adoption & Engineering Enablement

Mentor engineers and testers on AI-enabled testing techniques, responsible AI usage, prompt engineering, and modern quality engineering practices.
Establish reusable templates, playbooks, and implementation patterns that allow AI-powered testing methodologies to scale across multiple projects and teams.

Improve Through Feedback
Identify why a testing approach or automation practice isn't being adopted by a team, and adjust it based on the root cause rather than assumption.
Capture what works and what doesn't from each rollout and feed it back into shared standards and frameworks.
Coordinate with development and deployment teams to ensure testing connects smoothly with what comes before and after it in the delivery pipeline.

title: Data & Intelligence Analyst
tagsAndSkills: Business Intelligence,Data Enrichment,Data Mining,Data Analysis,Power BI,generative ai,Benchmarking,Data Extraction
jobDescription:
We are hiring a Data & Intelligence Analyst to own our data work end to end: getting hold of the data we need, turning it into clean and reliable datasets, producing the analysis, and delivering the reports and dashboards our clients commission.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not a support-only one. You will be given the question that matters. From there it is yours: work out where the data lives, go and get it, make it trustworthy, work out what it says, and deliver it as something a senior decision-maker can act on. You own the method, the definitions, the quality, and the finished product.

The bar is high. This work goes in front of senior people who will ask exactly how each number was produced, and you need to be able to answer.

Your core advantage is that you work fluently with AI. You use AI tools not as a novelty but as the way you operate: to gather, classify and analyse data, to move faster, and to produce more, better. That fluency is central to the role.

This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates based anywhere.

Working hours
Monday to Friday: 9am to 6pm UK time.
Saturday: 9am to 1:30pm UK time.

The Role: AI-Native, used centrally throughout

You will:

  • Define exactly which records are in scope for each piece of analysis, source them from licensed data providers, APIs and public sources, and verify how much of the intended set you actually managed to capture before you rely on it.
  • Acquire supporting data from wherever it exists: public registers, official statistics, published datasets, international government sources, and formal information requests.
  • Assemble everything into clean, structured, reliable datasets, including the unglamorous work of reconciling the same entity appearing under four different names across four different sources.
  • Normalise high volumes of inconsistent free-text values into a clean, consistent and defensible set of categories, and keep that mapping stable over time.
  • Work out what the data implies where it does not state it directly, inferring what you need from the fields you do have. Document the method and measure how often it is right.
  • Own the classifications and definitions: how records map to categories, how comparison groups are defined, how each metric is calculated. Keep them stable so this quarter's analysis is comparable with the last one.
  • Define every metric precisely and stand behind it. Where a figure is directly observed, say so. Where it is estimated, build the model, document it, validate it against external benchmarks, and label it on the output.
  • Own the end-to-end production of our client-facing reports, from raw data to a finished, polished document, delivered inside the committed window.
  • Produce the analysis, the comparisons and the charts, and write the interpretation and recommendations that go with them: concise, evidence-led, and in plain English a busy reader understands in thirty seconds.
  • Handle the awkward realities of large record-level datasets: missing fields, inconsistent naming, partial dates, duplicates, and knowing when a small sample cannot carry a percentage.
  • Explain and defend your methodology when someone challenges it, including its limitations, honestly.
  • Build and maintain our recurring datasets and tracked indicators, refreshed to a calendar, so the picture is always current rather than assembled in a panic.
  • Compare data across different countries and reporting systems, and know when two numbers that look comparable are not.
  • Specify the dashboard versions of our products precisely enough for our engineers to build them: the data model, the filters, the comparison logic, and the refresh cycle.
  • Turn each piece of work into a repeatable process. The second time should be much faster than the first, and the tenth should be close to routine.
  • Use AI across the whole workflow to work faster and better than a traditional analyst.
  • Flex onto other data work across the business when needed, from marketing and funnel analysis to commercial modelling and market research.

The work spans everything the business needs evidence for, wherever a sharp and reliable analyst is most useful. You are the person who makes sure the data exists, the numbers are right, the method is defensible, and the finished product is excellent.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 6 years in a data, analytics or research role where you owned an analytical output and delivered it to someone who relied on it, not just supported someone else's reports.
  • You go and get data rather than waiting for it. You have worked with datasets you had to assemble yourself, not only ones that were handed to you clean.
  • Genuinely good with data: you can take a large, messy, inconsistent dataset and make it tell the truth.
  • Comfortable with data far too large for a spreadsheet. Working SQL and/or Python, and strong in Excel.
  • Experience with large record-level datasets, including data licensed from third-party providers, and the judgement to work out whether a provider's coverage is genuinely what they claim.
  • Experience classifying and standardising messy real-world data, for example mapping thousands of free-text values into a clean set of categories.
  • Comfort working out what a dataset implies where it does not say so explicitly, and honesty about the error rate when you do.
  • Strong data visualisation: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or an AI-built equivalent. Whatever you use, you produce a clear, polished result and can explain exactly why you chose that view.
  • Excellent written English, with the ability to turn analysis into a clear, concise piece of writing that reads as yours. This is essential and will be assessed.
  • Good judgement about certainty. You define your metrics before you calculate them, you know the difference between a real finding and a coincidence, you label estimates as estimates, and you will not let a number ship that you cannot defend to someone who challenges it.
  • Genuine, demonstrable fluency with AI tools as a core part of how you work, with concrete examples, not just "I use ChatGPT sometimes".
  • Strong ownership: you take an ambiguous problem, work out the steps yourself, and come back with a finished answer rather than a list of questions.
  • Organised and reliable: commissioned work runs to a deadline and recurring work runs to a schedule, and you hit both.
  • Comfortable working fully remote.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a role where the core task was assembling a target list or dataset from third-party and public sources, for example market mapping, competitive intelligence, or data enrichment for sales or marketing.
  • Experience collecting data from web sources and APIs.
  • Experience building a benchmarking product, an index, a scoring model, or any analysis that compares organisations against a peer set.
  • Experience evaluating and buying third-party data.
  • Experience with public records research, freedom of information requests, or government and official statistics sources.
  • A statistics or economics background, or a track record of self-taught rigour.
  • Comfort with marketing and funnel data, or with commercial and financial modelling.
  • Building automations and data pipelines (Python, SQL, n8n, or AI-driven workflows).

Passion for AI Innovation

You are deeply excited about the transformative potential of AI and committed to contributing to a company shaping the future of work. With curiosity and a growth mindset, you continuously seek to learn, adapt, and stay at the forefront of new developments. Your enthusiasm for innovation drives you to explore new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find creative solutions that deliver meaningful impact. You approach your work with energy and a desire to advance both technology and the way we work.

jobDescription:
• Bachelor s or Master s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering

  • 3- 8 years of relevant experience in mechanical simulation, structural analysis, or CAE

    Strong fundamentals in:

  • Mechanics of materials
  • Structural mechanics and dynamics

  • Finite Element Method (FEM) theory


    Hands-on experience with FEA software, such as:

  • ANSYS Mechanical / Workbench
  • Abaqus and/or LS-DYNA (explicit experience is a plus)
  • Working knowledge of CAD tools such as SolidWorks or CATIA
  • Understanding of meshing techniques, element selection, and convergence studies
  • Ability to interpret complex simulation data and translate results into engineering insights
  • Good communication skills and ability to document technical findings clearly
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Experience with explicit dynamics (impact, drop, crash-type simulations)
  • Exposure to HyperMesh or similar pre-processing tools
  • Basic scripting or automation experience using Python or VB
  • Familiarity with design optimization or DOE (Design of Experiment) techniques
  • Exposure to physical testing and test simulation correlation

  • Understanding of failure criteria and damage modeling

  • Develop, execute, and review Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations using commercial Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) tools to evaluate structural performance
  • Perform a range of analyses, including:
    • Linear and nonlinear static analysis
    • Dynamic analysis (Modal Analysis, Harmonic Analysis, Random Vibration Analysis, Impact/Drop Analysis)
    • Thermal and thermo-mechanical coupled simulations
    • Fatigue analysis (High Cycle Fatigue (HCF) / Low Cycle Fatigue (LCF))
    • Seismic Simulations
  • Build simulation models with appropriate material models, boundary conditions, contacts, and loading scenarios
  • Apply knowledge of material behavior (metals, plastics, hyper elastic materials, and basic failure models) in simulations
  • Evaluate simulation results to identify stress, deformation, fatigue life, and failure risks
  • Perform hand calculations and engineering checks to validate FEA results using first principles
  • Support Verification and Validation (VV) efforts by correlating simulation outcomes with physical test data
  • Assist in root-cause analysis and failure investigations using simulation results
  • Prepare clear technical reports and documentation for internal stakeholders and customers
  • Collaborate with design, test, and manufacturing teams to support simulation-driven design improvements
  • Ensure simulation approaches align with industry standards and guidelines (e.g., American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), International Organization for Standardization (ISO), American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM))
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of modeling practices, templates, and workflows

    • Integrate models with client-facing applications, ensuring end-to-end implementation.

title: Sr Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Apple Devices Tenant Migration)
tagsAndSkills: jamf,conditional access,ai,employee referral,endpoint management,bonds,microsoft security,mac os
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on-shift technical authority for high-volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi-entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook driven waves of Mac OS device transition, Kandji/IRU or Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Platform Single Sign-On (PSSO) activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands-on migration execution, technical leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift level triage for device migration failures (Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
  • Validate pre req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce go/no go criteria.
  • Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re registration timing, end user reset/re provisioning coordination).
  • Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
  • Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
  • Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three shift model.
  • Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
  • Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Kandji/IRU / Jamf escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
  • Lead post migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Qualifications

Must Have (or equivalent experience):

  • Delivered at least one production M365 tenant to tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Mac OS device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Jamf, Kandji/IRU, Mac OS provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
  • Hands on experience with Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
  • Competence in Platform Single Sign-On (PSSO) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
  • Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
  • Strong PowerShell and Mac OS specific automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
  • Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good to Have:

  • Experience using profile preservation / workstation migration tooling (e.g., JAMF, IRU/Kandji or equivalent) to reduce user disruption and post cutover issues.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft security controls impacting devices (Conditional Access trust settings, compliant/hybrid joined trust, device-based access patterns).
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: MD 102, MS 102, SC 300 or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting global migrations with remote user populations and proactive comms/coordination playbooks.
  • ITIL practice awareness (incident/problem/change flow) or equivalent operational governance background.

Interpersonal Consulting Skills

  • Leads with calm operational control under pressure; sets the tone for disciplined factory execution and avoids heroics that compromise repeatability.
  • Communicates clearly in shift handovers: concise status, crisp risk articulation, unambiguous next actions.
  • Coaches engineers in-flight (without slowing throughput), raising capability by reinforcing patterns, not ad hoc fixes.
  • Confident challenging readiness gaps ( not ready to migrate ) using evidence and agreed criteria.
  • Builds trust quickly with cross functional teams (Identity, Security, Shared Data, Service Desk/hypercare) to remove blockers.
  • Demonstrates ownership: takes problems to closure, documents learning and drives runbook improvements.
  • Works effectively across cultures and time zones; assumes positive intent and maintains high standards.
  • Treats the client environment with professional discipline: secure handling of access, data and evidence artefacts.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: devices migrated per shift / per wave vs plan.

title: Data Scientist 2
jobDescription:
Data Scientist - 2 (DS-2)

Job family: Data Science
Level: DS-2 (equivalent to MLE-2 / AIE-2)
Scope of impact: Feature
Theme: Grows and Acts completes scoped modelling tasks and
improves team process

Why this role exists

Product outcomes need deep problem ownership and tight iteration
with PMs and product engineering. A DS-2 turns a scoped product
problem into a calibrated model or decision system, ships it
through the standard production path, and owns its performance
after launch. You operate with minimal guidance on a defined
feature, not the whole domain.

What you own

- A scoped modelling problem framed as a DS task: hypothesis,
success metric, offline and online evaluation plan.
- Calibrated predictive or causal models with well-behaved
probabilities and effect estimates.
- Repeatable pipelines integrated with production workflows, not
one-off notebooks.
- Basic model monitoring for the features you ship.
- Post-launch performance of your model and its link to the
target KPI; iterate using telemetry.

What you do not own (yet)

- Platform uptime and shared serving infrastructure (ML
Engineering owns this).
- Domain-wide priority setting across multiple initiatives (DS-3
and above).

What youll do (proficiency expectations at L2)

Data-driven decision making
- Build calibrated predictive or causal models with sound
probability and effect estimates.
- Articulate the impact of uncertainty and select an applicable
course of action with minimal guidance.
- Stress-test findings with simple mental models or simulations
before trusting them.

Technical expertise
- Set up fully reproducible environments for your own work and
share the guides with peers.
- Package work into repeatable pipelines and integrate them with
production workflows.
- Implement basic model monitoring.

Applied ML/AI/DS
- Frame and scope an opportunity as a DS problem, and pick the
right solution family (prediction, optimization, causal).
- Review recent literature, build reproducible pipelines, and
fairly compare alternative models.
- Run controlled pilots that connect model uplift to a target
KPI.

Experimentation and inference
- Frame a testable hypothesis and pick the right design (A/B or
hold-out).
- Run multi-metric or stratified tests with power checks and
CUPED variance reduction.
- Conclude using confidence intervals, state the limitations,
and tie results back to a target KPI.

Strategy and influence
- Scope an opportunity into a well-posed DS problem, naming the
RoI and the product and process changes it implies.
- Align stakeholders on the KPI leverage of a proposed approach
and secure agreement on scope and goals.
- Coordinate with engineering and product leads to launch
features where the model provides core value; shape planning and
risk assessment.

How you work with others

- PM: co-own the outcome and prioritisation for your feature.
- Product Engineering: integrate your model into customer-facing
experiences.
- ML Engineering / AI Engineering: consume platform primitives;
collaborate on evaluation, reliability gates, and production
readiness.

What we expect from a strong DS-2

- Ships production artifacts on the standard path, not
prototypes that stall at the production boundary.
- Improves at least one team process (templates, reviews,
reproducibility) beyond their own tasks.
- Owns outcome integrity: model outcomes stay aligned with
product outcomes after launch.

title: Partnership Manager

jobDescription:
Hello, We are Hiring Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships at Link Publishers Pvt. Ltd

Experience: 3 5 Years
Department: Sales & Partnerships
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

3. CXO & Decision-Maker Outreach

Identify and connect with relevant decision-makers, including:

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

The role requires thoughtful outreach rather than sending generic templates.

Before contacting a prospect, you should understand:

What does their company do Where can Link Publishers fit What value can we add Who is the right person to approach What should the partnership proposal look like

4. Personalized Email Outreach

Strong email writing is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements
2/ Conducting discovery calls
3/ Presenting relevant API/white-label solutions
4/ Coordinating product demonstrations
5/ Discussing commercial models
6/ Coordinating technical discussions with internal teams
7/ Following up with stakeholders
8/ Managing NDA/documentation requirements
9/ Moving opportunities toward integration and launch

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how APIs work from a business and product perspective.

What Were Looking For

Experience: 3 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, SaaS Sales, Strategic Alliances, API Partnerships, SEO SaaS, or a similar role.

The ideal candidate should have:

1/ Strong understanding of SaaS products and online business models.
2/ Good understanding of SEO and link building.
3/ Ability to research and understand new products independently.
4/ Ability to identify API integration opportunities.
5/ Experience communicating with founders and CXO-level stakeholders.
6/ Excellent written English and email communication.
7/ Strong personalization and cold outreach skills.
8/ Ability to convert product research into a compelling partnership proposition.
9/ Confidence conducting discovery and partnership calls.
10/ Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
11/ Commercial mindset and ability to think beyond traditional sales.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to code for this role.

However, you should understand basic concepts such as:

API integrations, SaaS platforms, data exchange, product integrations, white-label solutions, marketplaces, and reseller models.

You should be able to communicate a potential integration use case clearly enough for product and technical teams to take the discussion forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of emails sent.

We will primarily look at the quality and business impact of partnerships generated, including:

Relevant companies identified Decision-makers contacted Qualified partnership conversations API/White-label opportunities Commercial discussions Signed partnerships Successful integrations

The objective is to build long-term distribution and technology partnerships that allow Link Publishers inventory and link-building capabilities to reach customers through other products and brands.

About Link Publishers

Link Publishers is a link-building marketplace that connects businesses, agencies, and SEO professionals with publishers across multiple industries and markets.

Through our API and white-label solutions, partners can integrate link-building capabilities into their own products or offer link-building services under their own brand while Link Publishers supports the inventory and fulfillment from the backend.

We are looking for someone who can identify where these partnerships make sense and turn those opportunities into scalable business relationships.

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities :

We are looking for a GCP Cloud Platform Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Python and SQL.


Were Hiring | GCP Cloud Platform Engineer – MBSE
Job ID: MBSE Global Cloud Platform Requirement – 1
Experience: 4–6 Years
Location : Chennai
CTC: As Per Right Candidature
Domain: Automotive / Engineering / MBSE
Role: GCP Cloud Platform Engineer

The candidate will work on cloud migration, distributed job orchestration, AI/ML training pipelines and scalable cloud infrastructure supporting engineering simulation workloads.


1. Distributed Systems & Messaging Concepts
This is the most critical conceptual domain knowledge, separate from just "knowing the Pub/Sub API":

At-least-once delivery semantics understanding that messages can be delivered more than once, and why your worker code needs to be idempotent (i.e., safe to run twice without corrupting data)
Ack deadlines and lease extension since FEA jobs can run long, the candidate needs to understand how to extend acknowledgment deadlines for long-running tasks (otherwise Pub/Sub will think the worker died and redeliver the job to someone else)
Dead-letter queues knowing how to design a "graveyard" queue for jobs that fail repeatedly, so bad jobs don't loop forever
Ordering guarantees (or lack thereof) Pub/Sub doesn't guarantee message order by default, so if job sequencing matters at all, they need to know how ordering keys work
2. GCP-Specific Infrastructure Knowledge
IAM & service accounts — Pub/Sub and Vertex AI both rely heavily on fine-grained permissions; candidate should know how to scope service accounts securely (principle of least privilege) rather than granting broad access
Terraform provider quirks for GCP — the google Terraform provider has specific resource types for Pub/Sub topics/subscriptions and Vertex AI that behave differently than generic cloud resources
Networking basics (VPC, firewall rules) — especially if worker workstations are on-prem/local and need secure connectivity to GCP resources
3. Container & CI/CD Domain Knowledge
Docker fundamentals — building lean, reproducible training containers
Cloud Build pipeline syntax and triggers — knowing how to wire up automated builds tied to Git pushes or version tags
Vertex AI-specific packaging conventions — Vertex AI Custom Jobs expect containers to follow certain conventions (entrypoints, environment variables like AIP_MODEL_DIR, etc.)
4. Cross-Language Integration Knowledge (the unusual one)
MATLAB-to-GCP interoperability — this is a genuinely rare skill. Most cloud engineers have never touched MATLAB. Candidate should know either:
MATLAB's limited native GCP support, or
How to call GCP REST APIs / gRPC directly from MATLAB when no SDK exists
This is worth flagging as a "nice to have but rare" — you may need to accept a candidate who is strong on the Python/Pub/Sub side and pair them with someone who knows MATLAB, rather than expecting one person to have both.
5. Light Domain Knowledge of FEA / Engineering Simulation Workflows (Optional but valuable)
They don't need to be an FEA engineer, but understanding basics like:
Why FEA jobs can run for a long time and vary a lot in duration (which affects ack-deadline and autoscaling design)
The nature of "design info" as structured/large input files (which affects how you'd design message payloads — likely passing references/pointers to storage rather than raw data through Pub/Sub, since Pub/Sub has message size limits)
This helps them make smarter architecture decisions (e.g., knowing Pub/Sub messages are capped at 10MB, so large FEA design files should live in Cloud Storage with just a reference/URL passed in the message)
6. ML/AI Training Pipeline Knowledge
Basic ML training workflow concepts — checkpointing, distributed training, GPU utilization — to make good decisions about Vertex AI machine types and scaling
Vertex AI's job specification format — different from Cloud Run Jobs' YAML/config structure, so familiarity with translating one into the other is valuable

Candidate has to undergo scripting test in SQL during interview.



Preferred candidate profile :


Pub/Sub Migration (Job Orchestration)
• Redesign our current BigQuery-based job orchestration system (jobs table with lease/complete state transitions, driven by frequent small DML updates) into a Pub/Sub-based work-queue architecture
• Rework existing Terraform-managed infrastructure to provision Pub/Sub topics, subscriptions, IAM, and dead-letter handling
• Update local worker client code (Python and MATLAB) to consume from Pub/Sub instead of polling BigQuery
• Design for idempotency and safe handling of redelivery/ack-deadline edge cases given long-running FEA jobs
• Address MATLAB's lack of native Pub/Sub SDK support (e.g., via REST/gRPC integration)
Vertex AI Migration (AI Training Pipeline)
• Migrate an existing containerized Python training pipeline from Cloud Run Jobs to Vertex AI (Custom Training Jobs) to resolve compute scaling limitations
• Set up Vertex AI infrastructure and Cloud Build CI/CD pipelines for containerized training jobs
• Port existing training codebase with minimal disruption, resolving environment/resource-spec differences between Cloud Run and Vertex AI
